details.description: Multi-colour liquid Kumkum 11 in1 pack. For a touch of traditional charm, this Liquid Kumkum is perfect. With a fine and smooth application, you can create any look you want from classic traditional to contemporary chic.

Eyetex Divyaa Premium Kumkum is a beloved traditional cosmetic product in India that has been used for generations to enhance the beauty of women. This premium kumkum is meticulously crafted to add a touch of elegance to your beauty routine. Made from the finest ingredients, it offers a vibrant and long-lasting colour payoff. The smooth texture ensures effortless application, allowing you to create intricate designs with ease. Whether it's for daily use, festivals, or special occasions, Eyetex Divyaa Premium Kumkum is the perfect choice to enhance your moments.
details.usageInstructions:
Take a small amount of the kumkum on the provided applicator or a clean, dry brush.
Gently tap off any excess kumkum. Apply it on the desired area of the face, such as the forehead or the parting of hair.
For more intricate designs, use the fine tip of the applicator to create precise patterns.
Allow the kumkum to dry completely before touching or applying any other makeup products.
To remove the kumkum, use a gentle cleanser or wipe with a soft, damp cloth.

details.description: Look super radiant in the traditional, with this liquid kumkum from Eyetex. With a delicate, smooth matte finish, it completes your desi look and provides you with all the attractiveness if you are going out wearing any traditional outfit. This liquid kumkum is available in 6 different shades and this one is maroon. Skin-friendly and in a liquid variant, by using it you can complete your beautiful desi look in just a go. So, what are you waiting for? Add up to the outfits you carry around and call it a beautiful take.
details.ingredients: Aqua, Cellulose Gum, Xanthan Gum, May Contain CI 15880:1, CI 15850:1, CI 77266, CI 12120, CI 77891, CI 51319, CI 12085, CI 11680
details.usageInstructions:
Wash your face. Remove excess from the brush tip and apply it to the forehead.
It has a shelf life of 3 years. Storage Instructions: Best to be stored in a cool and dry space.

details.description: Experience the ultimate in skin-friendly luxury with Eyetex Pallavi Mangal Liquid Sindoor! This exceptional product combines the nourishing goodness of aloe vera and papaya fruit extracts. Achieve a flawless semi-matte finish that lasts all day, thanks to its waterproof formula. With its quick-drying formula, you can effortlessly apply this sindoor and be ready to conquer the day. With Eyetex Pallavi Mangal Liquid Sindoor, you can elevate your daily look to the next level. Choose from our range of six rich colours to find the perfect shade for your skin tone and style, and experience the difference that our high-quality sindoor can make. Elevate your beauty routine with this exquisite sindoor that not only enhances your appearance but also cares for your precious skin.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake well before use. Unscrew the cap, gently dip the soft-bristled applicator into the liquid sindoor and remove any excess product from the sides of the bottle.
Draw a thin line along the parting of your hairline or the center of your forehead, using the applicator.
For a bolder look, draw a thicker line or apply a second coat after the first coat dries.
Allow the sindoor to dry for a few seconds.
To remove the sindoor, use a cotton ball or a makeup remover.
